protocol.signal: one decision per fully closed M15 candle; no daily or session entry caps; same-timestamp quality ordering
protocol.execution: historical broker bid/ask M1; STOP, LIMIT or MARKET entry; broker minimum protection filter; SL-first intraminute ambiguity
protocol.risk: EUR 500 start; target 3% per trade; actual risk constrained by 90% margin utilization, slot budget, leverage and 100-unit rounding
protocol.portfolio: one occupied order/position per symbol; 0-minute cooldown; global 10% daily and 20% weekly loss breakers; slots 1,2,3; currency exposure none,no-shared
protocol.trailing: activation/BE checked at the selected monitor cadence; broker-native trailing then approximated continuously with M1 extremes
protocol.pendingInvalidation: enabled; M1 high/low cancels stop-only touches; simultaneous entry/stop touch resolves conservatively as fill then stop-loss

limitations: This is inspected development evidence, not a fresh holdout; slot/cadence selection is post-hoc and must be forward validated.
Broker tick order inside each M1 candle is unavailable; ambiguous stop/target/trailing paths use a conservative stop-first rule.
Current account-specific broker margin factors, minimum size and minimum distance are enforced; their historical changes and transient rejections are unavailable.
Financing, swaps and transient broker minimum-distance changes are not modeled.
